review_mode: Codex author self-review; candidate task acceptance only

criteria.criterion: Exercise valid proposals and representative semantic, proof and freshness failures.
criteria.finding: Nineteen real CLI/CI cases exercise all four commands, both instance profiles, valid extension/replay/proof evidence and actual semantic, proof, source-currentness and transport failures. Owned outcomes and exact required inventories were audited against the current accepted exports.

criteria.criterion: Diagnostics identify the obligation, offending relation and next actionable step.
criteria.finding: Semantic diagnostics name the offending relation kind and assertion, exact failed obligation, input location and corrective action. Invalid inputs return one JSON outcome, and proof rejection is distinguished from mathematical refutation.

failure_controls.control: CI execution success alone cannot mean semantic readiness.
failure_controls.finding: CI runs the local checker and requires independently complete completed/current review readiness. Actual successful single-check execution returns CI code 4; process failure and inconsistent stale readiness cannot pass.

failure_controls.control: Failing or unsupported mandatory checks must not return an accepted verdict.
failure_controls.finding: Wrong relation versions, actual weak proofs, stale proofs/bundles, unsupported meanings/changes and omitted hard obligations all return nonzero exits and never readiness.
